name: easyi18n
description: The easyi18n MCP server, with skills to set up a Flutter, Xcode, Angular, web or Android project and to translate and publish it. With your easyi18n login, Claude spends and publishes as you; with an agent key, every spend, publish and rollback waits for a human approval in the easyi18n dashboard.

token.title: easyi18n agent key
token.description: Optional. Leave it empty to use your easyi18n login. An Agent key (eik_...) from Project > Settings > API keys > New API key, Used by: AI agent, makes every spend and publish wait for a human approval.
